market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound (5,800–6,100 ^AXJO) as Wall Street AI rally offsets iron ore weakness and rate fears. Oil below $100 and diesel shock add volatility. Bragg super-mortgage announcement could trigger sector rotation. Gold juniors outperform on discovery flow.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from China slowdown, housing correction, and higher-for-longer rates cap upside. Gold and healthcare (CSL.AX) offer relative strength. Super policy evolution and energy transition are key 12-month themes. China recovery or further deterioration will be the swing factor for miners.
